before.title: to one's + 情緒名詞
before.content: 凡表情緒的名詞如 excitement、sorrow、delight、joy、disappointment、satisfaction 等，均可與介詞 to 並用；to one's + 情緒名詞，意為「令某人……的是」。

after.title: to one's + 情緒名詞
after.content: to one's + 情緒名詞：令某人……的是。本頁的 excitement、sorrow、delight、joy、disappointment、satisfaction 等可用此構式，表示對事情的情緒反應；不表示任何情緒名詞都能機械代入。

changes.reason: Qualify the listed construction without deleting any of its real examples.

after.title: in the wood / woods
after.content: 在樹林裡；在森林裡。wood 作單數亦可指一片樹林；此片語不是指在某一棵樹的內部。

changes.reason: Translate the woodland sense precisely while retaining singular and plural alternatives.

before.title: favor A over B
before.content: 贊同 A 而不贊同 B，喜歡 A 勝於 B

after.title: favor A over B
after.content: 偏愛 A 勝於 B；較支持 A。這個比較本身不表示完全不喜歡或反對 B。

changes.reason: A comparative preference does not entail complete opposition to the other option.

before.title: vocational education / training
before.content: *n.* 職業、使命。have a vocation for ...；相關 career / occupation / profession / vacation；形容詞 vocational，vocational education / training。

after.title: vocational education / training
after.content: vocational education / training：職業教育／職業訓練。vocational 為形容詞，表示與職業技能或就業準備相關。

changes.reason: Supply the actual phrase translation instead of repeating the same general noun paragraph.

before.title: career / occupation / profession / vacation
before.content: *n.* 職業、使命。have a vocation for ...；相關 career / occupation / profession / vacation；形容詞 vocational，vocational education / training。

after.title: career / occupation / profession / vacation
after.content: vocation 可指職業、志業或使命感；career、occupation、profession 各有職涯、工作或專業的不同側重。vacation 指假期／度假，與 vocation 是拼字相近的不同字，不是職業義的同義詞。

changes.reason: Keep the related-word list while distinguishing the real vacation homograph boundary.

before.title: have a vocation for ...
before.content: *n.* 職業、使命。have a vocation for ...；相關 career / occupation / profession / vacation；形容詞 vocational，vocational education / training。

after.title: have a vocation for ...
after.content: have a vocation for ...：有從事……的強烈志向或使命感；常用於某種職業或活動。

changes.reason: Make the existing construction meaning explicit.

before.title: sb's bark is worse than sb's bite

after.title: sb's bark is worse than sb's bite
after.content: 嘴上說得很凶，實際行動沒有說的那麼厲害；常譯為「刀子口豆腐心」。這個片語比較言語與行動，不保證當事人所有行為都溫和。

changes.reason: Retain the common Chinese idiom with a precise scope instead of asserting an invariably kind nature.

after.title: give a bark
after.content: 叫一聲；發出吠聲。bark 在 give a bark 中是名詞。

changes.reason: Make the sound noun in the actual phrase visible; this is precision, not a claim that the prior brief gloss was wholly wrong.
